summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly net asset value (NAV) per share as of July 31, 2026. The transaction price for each share class equals its NAV per share, ranging from $24.8802 (Class D) to $26.1540 (Class F). Total NAV was $1.403 billion across seven share classes, with assets primarily in commercial real estate loans. The filing is a routine monthly NAV update for a non-traded REIT, providing transparency to current stockholders. It does not involve any strategic transaction, corporate action, or special situation; it is purely a periodic financial disclosure required for share repurchase pricing.
